test_cases.actual_output: The context states that when the Englishman told the alchemist he wanted to learn how to make gold, the alchemist’s reply was simply: “Go and try.” Therefore, the alchemist’s initial counsel to the Englishman at the oasis was to “Go and try.”
test_cases.expected_output: The alchemist advised the Englishman to stop reading endlessly and to go and attempt the physical process of transformation himself.

test_cases.input: How did Santiago interpret the flight of the two hawks above the desert dunes?
test_cases.context: Watching two hawks diving and fighting in the desert sky, Santiago connected to the Soul of the World and received a vision of an armed army riding into the Al-Fayoum oasis to attack.
test_cases.actual_output: Santiago interpreted the flight of the two hawks as a connection to the Soul of the World, and the vision he received was of an armed army riding into the Al-Fayoum oasis to attack.
test_cases.expected_output: Santiago interpreted the colliding hawks as an omen that an enemy army was preparing to invade and attack the peaceful oasis.

test_cases.input: What wager did the tribal elders place on Santiago's prediction of the raid?
test_cases.context: The oasis chieftains decreed that if the enemy attacked, Santiago would receive a gold piece for every ten dead enemies, but if no weapons were used by sunset, a weapon would be used to execute him.
test_cases.actual_output: They bet that if the enemy attacked, Santiago would receive a gold piece for every ten enemies killed; if no weapons were used by sunset, a weapon would be used to execute him.
test_cases.expected_output: The chieftains offered Santiago gold for dead enemies if his warning proved true, but promised to execute him if no attack occurred.

test_cases.actual_output: He let Santiago’s horse run free, watched it stop at a rocky crevice, and then caught a live cobra there, using that situation to test Santiago’s ability to read omens.
test_cases.expected_output: The alchemist tested Santiago by challenging him to find life in the barren desert, which Santiago accomplished by trusting his horse to locate a venomous cobra.
